contents.title: Quiz Diagnostic 1ere Anglais - Serie 37
contents.subject: Anglais
contents.description: Diagnostic Anglais 1ere : Le comparatif et le superlatif

questions.question: Choose the correct comparative form: 'This exercise is ___ than the previous one.'
The superlative form of 'good' is 'the goodest'.
Traduis en anglais en utilisant la structure 'the + comparatif... the + comparatif' : 'Plus tu pratiques, meilleur tu deviens.'
Choose the correct superlative sentence:
choices: Mount Everest is the most high mountain in the world.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
Mount Everest is higher mountain in the world.
Mount Everest is the more high mountain in the world.

questions.question: 'She is as talented as her sister' expresses that the two sisters have an equal level of talent.
Corrige l'erreur dans la phrase suivante : 'This is the more interesting book I have ever read.'
Which sentence correctly uses 'fewer' or 'less'?
choices: There are less students in this class than last year.
There are fewer students in this class than last year.
There are fewer water in this bottle.
I have less books than you.

questions.question: 'The situation is getting worse and worse' uses a double comparative correctly to express a progressive change.

exercisenotion.description: Adjectifs courts (1 syllabe) : + er + than. Ex : tall → taller than, fast → faster than. Adjectifs longs (2+ syllabes) : more + adj + than. Ex : beautiful → more beautiful than. Irréguliers : good → better, bad → worse, far → farther/further. Égalité : as + adj + as. Infériorité : less + adj + than.

Adjectifs courts : the + adj + est. Ex : the tallest, the fastest. Adjectifs longs : the most + adj. Ex : the most beautiful. Irréguliers : good → the best, bad → the worst, far → the farthest/furthest. Le superlatif est toujours précédé de 'the'. Souvent suivi de 'in' (in the world) ou 'of' (of all).

Comparatif de supériorité : more and more + adj (de plus en plus). Double comparatif : the + comparatif..., the + comparatif (plus... plus...). Ex : The harder you work, the better results you get. Comparaisons avec noms : more/fewer (dénombrables), more/less (indénombrables).
